title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 32
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 32: a king reigning in righteousness, the careless women warned, and the Spirit poured out from on high.

questions.text: How will the king in this chapter reign?
questions.explanation: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in justice.

answers.text: With a rod of iron
In righteousness
Over all the nations
From sea to sea

questions.text: To what is a man compared in verse 2?
questions.explanation: A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind, a covert from the storm, streams of water in a dry place, and the shade of a large rock in a weary land.

answers.text: A watchman standing guard on the city wall
A green tree planted beside flowing waters
A bright lamp shining in a very dark place
A hiding place from the wind and the shade of a large rock

questions.text: What will the tongue of the stammerers be ready to do?
questions.explanation: The heart of the rash will understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly.

answers.text: Speak plainly
Sing praises
Keep silence
Speak in another language

questions.text: What will no longer happen to the fool?
questions.explanation: The fool will no longer be called noble, nor the scoundrel be highly respected.

answers.text: He will no longer sit in the gate
He will no longer speak in the assembly
He will no longer be called noble
He will no longer inherit the land

questions.text: What does the fool do to the hungry and the thirsty?
questions.explanation: The fool works iniquity, to make empty the soul of the hungry and to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

answers.text: He feeds them with bread at his own table
He makes empty the soul of the hungry
He sells them as slaves to the nations
He turns them away from the wedding feast

questions.text: Who are told to rise up and hear the speaker's voice?
questions.explanation: The call is: "Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!"

answers.text: The women who are at ease and the careless daughters
The elders who sit and judge in the gate
The princes and the rulers of the people
The watchmen standing guard on the walls

questions.text: Why will the careless women be troubled for days beyond a year?
questions.explanation: They will be troubled because the vintage will fail and the harvest won't come.

answers.text: Because the enemy will besiege the city
Because their husbands will fall by the sword
Because the wells will run dry
Because the vintage will fail and the harvest won't come

questions.text: What will the hill and the watchtower become?
questions.explanation: The palace will be forsaken and the city deserted; the hill and the watchtower will be dens forever, a delight for wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks.

answers.text: A place of appointed feasts and songs
A refuge for the poor and the needy
Dens forever, a delight for wild donkeys
A heap of ruins smoking to the sky

questions.text: Until what event will the desolation last?
questions.explanation: It lasts until the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field.

answers.text: Until the Spirit is poured on us from on high
Until the king returns from exile
Until seventy years are completed
Until the nations come to Zion

questions.text: What will the work of righteousness be?
questions.explanation: The work of righteousness will be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.

answers.text: Joy
Wisdom
Abundance
Peace
